errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос съдържа категориите – възрастовите групи, които са подредени отгоре надолу
errors.evidence: In a horizontal bar chart, the categories are listed on the vertical axis, while the values are represented on the horizontal axis. The description incorrectly swaps them.
In a horizontal bar chart, the values (in this case, percentages) are represented by the length of the bars along the horizontal axis, not the vertical axis.

errors.text_span: и 49,0 за „В много малка степен“ в групата „Лица от възрастовата група 35-44 г.“
errors.evidence: The description implies this is one of the highest values. However, the highest value for the category "В много малка степен" (To a very small extent) is 49.6 for the 45-54 age group, not 49.0.

errors.text_span: най-ниските са 1,3 за „Изобщо не са уязвими“ в групата „Непълнолетни лица“
errors.evidence: The description identifies 1.3 as a lowest value for the category "Изобщо не са уязвими" (Not at all vulnerable), but the actual lowest value for this category in the chart is 1.0 for the age group 18-24.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете са разположени по азбучен ред по хоризонталната ос
errors.evidence: The categories are listed on the vertical axis and are ordered by age group (from youngest to oldest), not alphabetically.
The description does not mention that there is no explicit horizontal axis with a scale, ticks, or labels. It incorrectly states that a 'vertical axis' has a linear scale.

errors.text_span: чиято дължина е пропорционална на сумата от процентите в съответната възрастова група
errors.evidence: This is a confusing way to describe a 100% stacked bar chart. The sum of percentages for each bar is 100, so all bars have the same total length. The description should state that the length of each segment is proportional to its percentage value.
